Mirai-Submission-Card.title: Some Instructions Byterunners!
body: Put your lovely offering or message or YT Link down below 💜
Please remember to submit only once.

After submitting, a small popup will appear at the top of the page That you have submitted , Once you click wait for that message to pop up. Depending on speed of Internet it will take time but clicking once it will give Success OR an error!
Once that’s done, click “Head to Basement Party”
I really hope you all enjoy my little surprise for Cutie Patootie Mirai 💜

byterunner1.title: Hello Byterunners
body: Thank you all for taking your time and doing this for Mirai. This website is for special occasion to give something special to our Yandere Queen as she is coming back from a long vacation
Mirai is our cutie patootie yandere cyberpunk queen, She can be a bit crazy but she is one of us , our family and we all love her deeply. So lets make this a special day for her and make her return -
BIG AND MOST FUN EVER that will make her cry like a baby and show her that we missed and loved her.

byterunner2.title: Hello Byterunners
body: Mirai is going to say few words here first!

Phantom-Card.title: CRAZY LADY!
body: Welcome back Milady! Hope your vacation was good and you had loads of fun. We were starving in your basement without you feeding us

I know I call you crazy lady and act all scared but its mostly just gimmick. In the end however you are whether crazy or your true self might be different that you dont show but in my eyes you are always Mirai, A cute friend that I like and care about.

Whenever I see you in chat or go live , Something excites me. Like a little kid that got his fav toy. Your presence to me is that much special. I hope you like this little suprise that we made for you!
Enjoy it and be always happy and cute! AND NEVER EVER LEAVE US AGAIN!
